description:
Rotary Club of Mumbai MaKaBo
Minutes of the Club Assembly Meeting

Date: Sunday, 2nd August 2026
Time: 9:30 AM
Venue: Sandeep's Office, Express Mall
Chair: Rtn. Navin R. Mishra, President (2026–27)

Members Present

Dr. Rtn. Avinash Sonawane, Rtn. Navin R. Mishra, Rtn. Sanjay, Rtn. Sandeep, Rtn. Ashok, Rtn. Kawan, Rtn. Lopa, Rtn. Sonali and Rtn. Kosha.

Key Discussions

1. Membership & Club Development

Club currently has 21 active members; retention and engagement to remain priorities.
Introduce a Buddy System for new members.
Encourage fellowship and meaningful induction of new members.
Explore youth engagement and formation of Rotaract Clubs.
Rtn. Lopa proposed a One-Day Marriage Counselling & Relationship Training Programme.

2. Projects

Reviewed Medical Camp, Dental Camp at Saphale, Raincoat Distribution and School Library projects.
Discussed follow-up dental treatment for Saphale beneficiaries.
Proposed projects include Mental Health, Preventive Healthcare, Rural Dental Awarenes
